data.value:
SRP :3.1M Varied widely by year and trim; originally positioned as a high-performance sports sedan (Currently available only on the used/import market)
SPECS:
Overall Dimensions (mm): 4,495 × 1,810 × 1,480 Wheelbase (mm): 2,650 Seating Capacity: 5
ENGINE / PERFORMANCE
Engine Options:
2.0 L 4-Cylinder Turbocharged Gasoline (4B11T)
Maximum Output: ~291 hp Maximum Torque: ~407 Nm
Transmission: 5-speed Manual or 6-speed Twin-Clutch SST Automatic (depending on variant)
Drivetrain: Full-Time All-Wheel Drive (AWD) with Super All-Wheel Control (S-AWC)
Performance (0–100 km/h): ~5.0–5.2 seconds (variant-dependent)
CAPACITY & CAPABILITIES
Towing Capacity: Not rated; performance-focused vehicle, not designed for towing
Payload Capacity: Approx. 400–450 kg
Fuel Tank Capacity: 55 L
INTERIOR / CABIN / SPACE
Seating: 5
Seats: Sport bucket seats (Recaro on higher trims)
Infotainment: Basic multimedia system (period-correct for its era)
Speakers: 6–9 (depending on trim)
CHASSIS / BRAKES / WHEELS / SUSPENSION
Front Brake / Rear Brake: High-performance ventilated disc brakes
Suspension: MacPherson Strut front, Multi-Link rear (sport-tuned)
Tires / Wheels: 18” Alloy Wheels with performance tires
Special Systems: Active center differential, torque vectoring, performance stability control
